# La Casa Verde by Montessori Minds

> Montessori school, nursery and pre-school in Choueifat, Lebanon for children from infancy through age six. Campus on Saida Old Road, Al Omara District. Hours Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–4:00 PM. Phone +961 71 007 150. Email hello@montessorimindslb.com.

Montessori Minds operates La Casa Verde with AMI- and AMS-informed classroom practice. Programs: Infant Community / Nido (birth–18 months), Toddler Community (18 months–3 years), and Children’s House pre-school (ages 3–6). Arabic, English and French are part of daily classroom life.
